title: Silver as an Inflation Hedge: What the Data Actually Shows
description: Silver gained 270% during the 1970s inflation surge and doubled in value from 2020 to 2022. Here is what three decades of data show about silver during high inflation periods.
alt: Three stat cards showing silver's 270% gain in the 1970s, 173% gain from 2008 to 2011, and 107% rise from 2020 to 2022
